blocks.title: Photovoltaic cell
blocks.text: The word photovoltaic is composed of photo (light) and volt (electrical potential). The cell that converts light energy into electrical energy is called a photovoltaic cell.
The next two topics give the principle of photovoltaic (PV) cells and their merits as a sustainable source of energy.

blocks.prompt: How does a photovoltaic cell differ from a galvanic cell in its energy source?
blocks.explanation: A galvanic cell converts the chemical energy of a spontaneous redox reaction into electrical energy, so it runs down as the reactants are used up. A photovoltaic cell converts light energy directly into electrical energy and keeps working as long as light falls on it, with no chemicals consumed.

items: Photovoltaic cell: light energy to electrical energy (photo = light, volt = potential).
